prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1026; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating to the bilateral trapezius region. Initial examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in extension and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Cervical radiographs showed no acute fracture or subluxation. A diagnosis of cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder was established.

Over the course of 12 visits, the patient received a combined treatment plan including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise focused on deep cervical flexor strengthening and scapular stabilization, and transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation for symptom control. Home exercise instruction and postural education were provided at each session. Pain levels improved steadily from initial reports of moderate to severe intensity to mild, intermittent discomfort by the final visit. Cervical range of motion improved substantially in all planes, and headache frequency decreased markedly.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical mobility with minimal residual tenderness and was independent with the home exercise program. Ongoing self-management and a return to usual activities were recommended, with re-evaluation advised should symptoms recur or worsen.
